list.title: Sudoku Generator and Solver
list.description:
- A Java based Sudoku generator, solvable and playable game. Recursive Backtracking and greedy iterative algorithms are used to generate puzzles across three difficulty levels. Three cell-removal strategies ranked against runtime and probability of generating a uniquely solvable Sudoku puzzle to justify which option use in the generator.
 - See the report here: [report.pdf](documents/report_cell_removal_methods.pdf)

list.title: Extended Project Qualification – Artificial Intelligence in Cybersecurity
list.description:
- Completed a dissertation considering the advantages and disadvantages of implementing Artificial Intelligence in cybersecurity protection methods.
- Considered current and planned use of Artificial Intelligence in enterprise endpoint threat detection software.
- Analysed the potential for AI-enabled cyberattack methods, particularly the use of Natural Language Processing in social engineering and phishing attacks.
- Achieved an **81% mark**.

list.title: Library Management System
list.description:
- Developed an object-oriented library management system with a Tkinter GUI supporting **1,000+ members** with role-based functionality for librarians.
 - Designed a SQLite relational database for members, books, and loans, implementing search and sorting functionality.
 - Conducted client interviews directly with librarians and users to identify problems with current management system and inform requirements.
 - Implemented login authentication system with secure password hashing, along with testing for input validation and parameterised SQL queries to prevent SQL injection.
 - See the report here: [report.pdf](documents/LMS_report.pdf)

list.title: Custom Home Lab Machine
list.description:
- Built and configured an Ubuntu Server home lab using Docker for self-hosted applications.
 - Measured power consumption and analysed estimated annual energy costs, documenting setup and results in a technical blog post.
